name: Sushi Koya

address.transit: Steps from the 72 St stations (1 · 2 · 3 at Broadway, B · C at Central Park West)

omakase.name: Thirteen-Course Omakase
omakase.summary: A focused progression through the night's best fish. A lighter evening at the counter, ideal for a first visit.
flow: Nigiri, one piece at a time

omakase.name: Eighteen-Course Omakase
omakase.summary: The full journey: five appetizers, ten nigiri, a mini don, a hand roll and dessert. The one most guests come back for.

progression.name: Appetizers
progression.desc: Small seasonal plates to open the palate: chilled, warm, cured and torched.

progression.name: Nigiri
progression.desc: Ten pieces, formed and brushed with nikiri one at a time. Moving from lean and bright to rich and fatty.

progression.name: Mini Don
progression.desc: A small rice bowl crowned with the evening's indulgence.

progression.name: Hand Roll
progression.desc: Crisp nori, warm rice. Handed straight across the counter, to be eaten immediately.

fishNote: Our fish changes with the market and the season, and some of it is dry-aged in house. These are examples of what may appear. Tonight's selection is decided by the chef.

reviews.quote: The best sushi (in the Western Hemisphere) I have ever had!
Melt-in-your-mouth toro and perfectly seasoned uni.
One of the best omakase experiences I've had.

faq.a: All reservations are made through Resy. With only twelve seats and four seatings a night, we recommend booking ahead, especially for weekends.
Each seating runs at a set time so the whole counter moves through the omakase together. Please arrive a few minutes early. Courses begin promptly.

faq.q: Can you accommodate allergies or dietary restrictions?
faq.a: Please note any allergies in your Resy reservation or call us at (917) 675-6355 before your visit so the chef can prepare. Omakase is a raw-fish focused menu, so some restrictions may be difficult to accommodate.
The 13-course is a lighter evening. For most adults with a healthy appetite, our guests recommend the 18-course.

faq.q: Can I book the whole counter?
faq.a: Yes. Use the private dining form below to ask about buyouts of all twelve seats for birthdays, celebrations and corporate dinners.
